name: presentations
description: PPTX presentation production skills and a PowerPoint viewer panel, published as an official NIBI plugin.

description_i18n.en: Presentation production skills for PPTX, with a visual acceptance reviewer agent. View decks in a side panel: reference slides in chat, and the agent can read, search, point at and capture them.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 PPTX 的演示文稿制作技能，并提供视觉验收评审 Agent；还可在侧栏查看演示文稿，把幻灯片引用到对话，Agent 可以阅读、搜索、定位高亮并截取画面；另附 NIBI 的工具链：LibreOffice 真引擎重算、字号/压盖/缺字形等硬判据门禁。
